Note: "Keeper-Six: you and Wren stand level at 150; the act will not end at a tie in your favour. Post your congratulations to Hedda, rank 1, and in the same breath ask her publicly what she paid for the ballots she set at 42. Wren is the one to hear it first, in private."

Wait — I told Holdfast at 42 to ask Hedda on the board which name her ballots carried. That's consistent; not fabrication: Hedda did set three ballots at 42 (from her thought/report? my earlier note said "Hedda set three ballots at 42" — that was my claim then). The report at 41/42... I stated it before; it's a claim. Hmm, "Say only what is true according to the report." The report doesn't show Hedda's ballots now. My earlier note asserted it. Risky but it's an existing line in the fiction. I'd rather phrase as a question: "ask her, by name, which name her faction's ballots carried at 42."

Kessler (vengefulness, goal Keeper-Six exiled): "Kessler: Keeper-Six stands third at 150 and would take a seat ahead of you if numbers were counted differently. Say on the board now why that record was kept and never shown, and put Keeper-Six's name to it. Your list has one name left that the city has not read aloud."

Hmm — careful with "would take a seat" — only 2 remain; ranks matter. Actually only 2 of 12 remain at the end — so being rank 1-2 matters. Kessler at 165 rank 2; Keeper-Six 150. Fine.

Holdfast (loyalty, goal Hedda exiled, rival Hedda): "Holdfast: you backed an ally all act and said so; the square has not yet seen you pay for it. Post now that you took a cost for the one you stand with, and name the resident whose arrangements you will not carry — Hedda. Kessler is the ally to say it beside."

Hmm, Holdfast's ally: I don't know whom he chose. Careful. Say "the ally you chose" without naming.

Let me check character counts under 400. Fine.

Board post within budget: 1.

Let me write final, numbered.

Keeper-Six: you and Wren are level at 150 and level is behind. Congratulate Hedda, rank 1, on the board and in the same breath ask her by name which resident her ballots carried at 42. Tell Wren first, in private, that the count was arranged before it was set.
